title: Editor
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (Editor object): defines the allowed value space for a property or command/linkdef parameter, referenced everywhere else by its `id` (Property.editor, Parameter.editor, LinkDef parameters' editor -- see property.schema.json/parameter.schema.json). Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's editor.schema.json, which is a `oneOf` of three shapes -- `{idref}`, inline min/max, inline subset -- because in ioxplugin's dialect a Property's `editor` field is itself an INLINE editor definition that may either be a full definition or a `{idref}` pointer to one defined elsewhere. Dynamic Profiles does not work that way: every editor is defined exactly once, here, in the top-level `editors` array, and every other object references it purely by id STRING (confirmed in src/nucore/profile.py -- `pdict["editor"]`/`p["editor"]` are always resolved via `get_editor(eid)` against the family-wide `editors_dict`). So this schema has no `idref` branch at all -- an Editor definition is always the full `{id, ranges}` shape; the reference indirection lives one level up, in the `editor` string fields on Property/Parameter/LinkParameter.

id.description: Editor id used by node properties or commands.

ranges.description: List of valid value ranges and constraints. Some editors legitimately offer more than one uom/range choice (e.g. a raw 0-255 value alongside a percentage) -- see src/nucore/editor.py's Editor.ranges docstring. Optional here (not just possibly-empty) because src/nucore/profile.py's parser reads it via `edict.get("ranges", [])`.
